scenario: [LNLS.3.7]: a regex match whose left operand is a `String` slot without `max_length` is a compile error in a `+nolinscan` file. `max_length` has no syntax, so every such match is refused -- the clause's own case, and the only one the language can express. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lnls_expr`'s `ex_match` arm through `string_slot`.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Line scope logical:
    k: Int key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Line l where l.text ~ /^ERR/
->
    log info "x"
